method.title: Scale aggregates before saturating nonlinearities
method.aphorism: Check scale before blaming the optimizer.
method.source_claim: The authors suspect larger dot products can saturate softmax and reduce gradients; they divide attention logits by the square root of key dimension.
method.interpretation: When attention gradients weaken as key dimension grows, inspect logit scale before changing optimization.
method.generalized_principle: Measure how aggregate variance changes with dimension before choosing a normalization factor.
method.trigger: Attention instability or softmax saturation when increasing key dimension.
method.action_bias: Inspect logit variance and gradient magnitude, then test scaling against a fixed baseline.
method.verification: Compare saturation and gradient statistics over multiple key dimensions; check that the source assumptions apply.
